Package com.google.adk.workflow

Class NodeExecutionState

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.workflow.NodeExecutionState
@Experimental public final class NodeExecutionState extends Object
The state of one workflow node run, held by the run's Context. Only the workflow runtime creates it and updates the bookkeeping that records which results an event has carried.

    • produceOutput

      public void produceOutput(Object output)
      Records the node's output, which an event carries when the node finishes unless an earlier event already carried it. A node produces at most one output.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the node already has an output.

    • selectedRoutes

      public Optional<com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<Route>> selectedRoutes()
      Returns the routes the node selected, which decide the outgoing edges to follow, or empty if it made no routing decision. An empty list is a decision that selects no route.

    • selectRoutes

      public void selectRoutes(List<? extends Route> routes)
      Selects the node's routes, replacing any earlier selection. An event carries them when the node finishes unless an earlier event already carried them.
